privileged_info_for_vlm: The project is located at ~/IdeaProjects/trading-orderbook. The test suite com.trading.OrderBookTest contains exactly 6 tests: testEmptyBookHasNoBestBidOrAsk, testBestBidIsHighestPrice, testBestAskIsLowestPrice, testAtParPriceOrdersAreMatched, testCrossedPriceOrdersAreMatched, and testPartialFillTracksRemainingCorrectly.
